newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CLINCH QUARTER-FINAL PLACE AFTER EPIC VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS CLINCH QUARTER-FINAL PLACE AFTER EPIC VICTORY.

text.p: European champions Juventus beat Manchester United 1-0 in an epic Champions' League match on Wednesday to clinch a place in the last eight of the European Cup.

The only goal of a truly memorable encounter came after 35 minutes when Alessandro Del Piero smacked the ball past United's Danish goalkeeper Peter Schmeichal from the penalty spot after he had been fouled by Nicky Butt -- and then made the most of the incident with a theatrical tumble.
Juventus gave United a lesson in movement and passing in the first half, then soaked up 45 minutes of relentless United pressure in the second.

United were a different team after the break, almost totally dominating the play, but the best they could give more than 53,000 desperate home fans was a series of near-misses, typified by a 20-metre shot from skipper Eric Cantona which clipped the bar in the dying minutes.

It was the first time United had ever lost to Italian opposition at home in Europe and their second successive home European defeat after their 40-year unbeaten home run was ended by Fenerbahce three weeks ago.
